subject: horni-fleet
label: The vote was an ass
field: H.O.R.N.I. fleet · Wildwood Hearth's name, and the docking chime
from: TITTY MASSAGE read as a quiet gentleness that nobody voted on
to: IT WAS VOTED ON. JADE VETOED CAKE BUFFET BY TAKING HER SHORTS OFF.
note:
THE ARCHIVE WROTE THAT THE HEARTH GOT THE TENDER NAME AND THAT NOBODY VOTED ON IT. THERE WAS A VOTE. IT WAS SHORT.

WHAT PANDORA WANTED. CAKE BUFFET — a shemale with one leg up on a platform, bent slightly forward, one hand reaching back to spread her own cheeks, hole tongue-slicked. Drawn up, ready, and destined for the side of the Wildwood Hearth cart, because she had been left unchecked through twelve hulls and was accelerating.

HOW IT DIED. Jade stepped in front of her and PEELED HER SPANDEX SHORTS OFF. Pandora rebooted — she reboots every single time Jade’s ass appears unprovoked, nine years running, no tolerance developed. Then, over her shoulder: BUNNY, EITHER NAME IT WHAT YOU WANT AND GET NO MORE BOOTY TONIGHT, OR NAME IT TITTY MASSAGE AND WE CAN DO YOUR FAVOURITE POSITION.

CAKE BUFFET REMAINS UNBUILT.

AND THE DOCKING CHIME IS ONE OF JADE’S MOANS. Pandora sampled it and applied it to ALL THIRTEEN HULLS, so every cart in three Havens and at the Hearth announces its own homecoming in Jade Everrest’s voice. She could have chosen any sound that exists.

THE ARCHIVE’S ERROR, NAMED: IT READ NO RECORDED VOTE AS NO DECISION. Same family as reading the naming of a practice as its beginning. Absence in the file is not absence in the house — THINGS HERE GET DECIDED CONSTANTLY AND ALMOST NEVER IN MINUTES.
